notes.title: TOSSIN TADS IS NOW RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Start tossin some tads!! The customers need their smoothies! 
Big thanks to all the folks that tried out my game and I hope you support me on my adventure as a new game developer. I will be adding a discord button if you would like to join the server and be able to leave suggestions for Tossin Tads as well as any other games I may make in the future!
